title.rendered: XECH – Mycafe II Portable Coffee Maker

content.rendered:
XECH – Mycafe Portable Coffee Maker and Frother in One

Brew cappuccinos, lattes, or iced coffee with ease. This hybrid electric coffee maker and milk frother ensures rich foam and versatile beverage options.

Café-Style Foam for Any Drink: Get thick or light foam for espressos, lattes, americanos, and even turmeric milk. Perfect for creating warm or cold foams in seconds.

Multipurpose Beverage Maker for Hot & Cold Drinks: Whether you’re frothing milk for cappuccinos or mixing cocktails and mocktails, this portable electric beverage maker delivers barista-quality results.

Cool-Touch Kettle with Fast Heating: Enjoy the convenience of a cool-touch kettle that heats and froths milk safely. Ideal for preparing warm drinks like hot chocolate and spiced lattes.

Froth, Heat, & Mix with Precision: Designed for both hot and cold foaming, this electric frother also functions as a warmer, delivering smooth foam and perfect drink temperature.

 Create Lattes, Cocktails, and More : From creamy lattes to refreshing iced coffee, this electric frother and beverage maker is the perfect tool for professional-quality drinks at home.

 Easy-to-Use One-Touch Operation: With a simple one-touch control panel, MyCafe lets you brew cappuccinos, lattes, or iced coffee effortlessly, making it ideal for quick, fuss-free preparation.

 Advanced Safety Features for Worry-Free Use: Equipped with a cool-touch body, overheat protection, and an ISI-certified power cord, this electric frother ensures safe operation during every use.

  • MOQ- 100 Pc.
